title: Cow wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='30' ry='18' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='2' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <rect x='42' y='84' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='84' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <rect x='68' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='2' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='92' width='7' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='42' y='92' width='7' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='92' width='7' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='92' width='7' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#6a5040'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='72' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6a5040'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8dcc8' transform='rotate(-20 30 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='38' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8dcc8' transform='rotate(20 70 38)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M36 32 Q33 24 38 22' stroke='#d4b896' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 32 Q67 24 62 22' stroke='#d4b896' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#4a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#e8a0a0'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#c07070'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#c07070'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 58 Q50 61 54 58' stroke='#c07070' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,10 38,32 62,32' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 44,21 56,21' fill='#ffd84a'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 47,15 53,15' fill='#5ad4ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='4' fill='#ffd84a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='21' r='2' fill='#5ad4ff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='21' r='2' fill='#ffd84a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='15' r='1.5' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='15' r='1.5' fill='#5ad4ff'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='24' height='4' rx='1' fill='#ffd84a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M80 66 Q88 62 86 70' stroke='#e8dcc8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='72' r='3' fill='#6a5040'/>
</svg>
